blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Weather fronts are transition regions between air masses with contrasting thermodynamic properties and are associated with mid-latitude precipitation and severe weather. We investigate machine learning (ML) methods for detecting weather fronts and quantify the contribution of reanalysis data to performance. We compare two configurations of the same ML model for pixel-wise frontal classification over the North Atlantic and Europe: (1) using only geostationary infrared satellite observations, and (2) additionally using 28 ERA5 reanalysis fields. The satellite-only model achieves a neighbourhood critical success index at a 150 km tolerance (CSI@150) of $0.402$, which lies within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services. The satellite$+$ERA5 model achieves $0.575$, an improvement of $0.173$. Our analysis shows that low-level winds are the least predictable from the satellite representation ($R^2 = 0.23$, compared with $0.88$ for temperature), while removing winds or moisture causes the largest decreases in detection performance.
blocks.zh: 气象战线是空气质量之间具有对比热力学特性的过渡区域,与中纬度降水和恶劣天气有关. 我们调查探测天气前沿的机器学习方法,量化重新分析数据对性能的贡献。 我们比较了北大西洋和欧洲同一种ML模型的前方像素分类的两个配置:(1) 只使用对地静止红外卫星观测,(2) 额外使用28个ERA5再分析场。 仅卫星模型在150公里(CSI@150)的容忍度上实现了邻近地区的关键成功指数,为0.402美元,这属于不同气象部门分析之间达成的协议范围。 卫星$+$ERA5模型达到0.575美元,改善1.73美元。 我们的分析表明,从卫星代表值(R^2 = 0.23美元,而温度为0.88美元)来看,低水平风的预测性最差,而去除风或湿度则造成探测性能最大的下降。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Weather fronts are narrow transition regions where air masses with contrasting thermodynamic properties meet, causing sharp changes in temperature, humidity, wind, and pressure ( Hewson, 1998 ; Biard and Kunkel, 2019 ) .
Detecting fronts matters for both weather forecasting and climate analysis, because a substantial fraction of extreme mid-latitude precipitation occurs near them ( Catto and Pfahl, 2013 ) .
Operational forecasters identify fronts manually ( Biard and Kunkel, 2019 ; Justin et al., 2025 ) from surface observations, satellite imagery, and numerical weather prediction (NWP) output. Independent meteorological services often analyse the same synoptic situation differently, because their local information, analysis conventions, and regional priorities differ. Automated methods, from thermodynamic diagnostics on gridded fields ( Hewson, 1998 ; Schemm et al., 2015 ) to deep learning models ( Biard and Kunkel, 2019 ; Lagerquist et al., 2019 ; Niebler et al., 2022 ; Justin et al., 2025 ) , offer objective and reproducible alternatives. Most rely on reanalysis, which combines historical observations with an NWP model to reconstruct past atmospheric states.
We study the automated pixel-wise classification of cold, warm, and occluded fronts over the North Atlantic and Europe.
blocks.zh:
天气战线是狭长的过渡区域,其空气质量与相差相差的热力学性质相会合,引起温度,湿度,风能和压力的剧烈变化(Hewson,1998;Biard and Kunkel,2019).
探测天气预报和气候分析的前沿问题,因为极低纬度降水有很大一部分发生在它们附近(Catto和Pfahl,2013年)。
业务预报员从地表观测、卫星图像和数值天气预测(NWP)产出中人工确定前沿(Biard和Kunkel,2019;Justin等,2025)。 独立的气象部门往往以不同的方式分析同样的综合情况,因为它们的地方信息、分析公约和区域优先事项不同。 自动化方法,从网格化场上热力学诊断(Hewson,1998;Schemm等,2015年)到深层学习模型(Biard and Kunkel,2019;Lagerquist等,2019;Niebler等,2022;Justin等,2025年),提供客观和可再生的替代品. 多数依靠再分析,将历史观测与NWP模型相结合来重建过去的大气状态.
我们研究在北大西洋和欧洲上空自动按像素对冷、暖和和被围住的战线进行分类。

blocks.en:
Detectors that rely on reanalysis or NWP fields lag behind the latest observations. Reanalyses such as ERA5 ( Hersbach et al., 2020 ) become available after several days and operational NWP analyses typically after a few hours, while real-time forecasts contain no observations made after their initialisation. Geostationary satellites, in contrast, observe the atmosphere several times per hour, so a satellite-only detector can run in near real time. However, infrared radiances do not directly measure the temperature, humidity, and wind fields that characterise frontal zones. Reanalyses estimate these fields by data assimilation. This trade-off motivates our question: what does reanalysis add beyond satellite observations for frontal detection?
We answer it by comparing satellite-only and satellite + + ERA5 detectors through cross-modal probing, variable-group ablation, and single-group addition.
blocks.zh:
依赖再分析或NWP域的探测器落后于最新的观测. 诸如ERA5(Hersbach等,2020年)等再分析在几天后开始提供,而操作性NWP分析一般在几个小时后提供,而实时预测则没有包含初始化后所作的观测. 相形之下,对地静止卫星每小时观测了几次大气层,因此只有卫星的探测器可以近实时运行. 然而,红外光线并不直接测量标出锋区特征的温度,湿度和风场. Reanalysis通过数据同化来估计这些领域. 这种取舍促使我们提出这样一个问题:除了卫星观测之外,在前方探测方面有什么新的分析?
我们通过比较卫星和卫星+ ERA5探测器通过跨模式验证,可变群衰减,以及单组加成.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Traditional objective frontal detection applies rule-based thermodynamic diagnostics to gridded atmospheric fields ( Hewson, 1998 ; Schemm et al., 2015 ) . The NWC SAF Automatic Satellite Image Interpretation (ASII) product ( NWC SAF, 2022 ) detects fronts in geostationary imagery with rule-based morphological analysis, optionally adding NWP fields, and is our reference baseline.
blocks.zh: 传统的客观前缘检测将基于规则的热力学诊断应用于被网格化的大气场(Hewson,1998;Schemm等,2015.). NWC SAF自动卫星图像解释(ASII)产品(NWC SAF,2022年)用有章可循的形态分析探测出地静止图象中的前沿,可选地添加NWP字段,是我们的参考基线.

blocks.en: Most deep learning approaches rely on reanalysis. Biard and Kunkel (2019) and Lagerquist et al. (2019) trained convolutional neural networks to detect atmospheric fronts over North America using reanalysis variables. Niebler et al. (2022) used multi-level ERA5 over Europe and North America and introduced label deformation for positional uncertainty, while Justin et al. (2025) developed FrontFinder AI (UNet3+), which is deployed operationally at NOAA. None of these studies evaluates a satellite-only configuration. Qin et al. (2025) combined geostationary imagery with ERA5-derived fields to detect cold fronts over East Asia, but did not consider other front types or isolate the contribution of ERA5 over satellite observations alone.
blocks.zh: 大多数深入学习的方法依赖于再分析. Biard and Kunkel (2019)和Lagerquist等人 (2019)培训了革命神经网络,利用再分析变量探测出北美各地的大气战线. Niebler等 (2022年)在欧洲和北美上空使用多级ERA5并引入了位置不确定性的标签变形,而Justin等 (2025年)开发了FrontFinder AI(UNet3+),在NOAA操作上部署. 这些研究都没有评价仅由卫星组成的配置。 秦等 (2025年)将地球静止图象与ERA5衍生场相合并,以探测东亚上空的冷锋,但并未考虑其他前沿类型,也未单独将ERA5的贡献与卫星观测相隔离.

blocks.en: Prior work therefore evaluates a fixed input configuration ( Biard and Kunkel, 2019 ; Lagerquist et al., 2019 ; Niebler et al., 2022 ; Justin et al., 2025 ; Qin et al., 2025 ) , sometimes ranking individual variables by importance ( Justin et al., 2025 ) . We instead compare satellite-only and satellite + + ERA5 models directly and identify which ERA5 variables add information beyond the satellite representation. This matters when designing detectors capable of operating in near real time without relying on reanalysis data.
blocks.zh: 因此,先前的工作评价了固定输入配置(Biard and Kunkel, 2019;Lagerquist等, 2019;Niebler等, 2022;Justin等, 2025;Qin等, 2025),有时按重要性对单个变量进行排名(Justin等, 2025). 相反,我们直接比较了仅卫星和卫星+ERA5模型,并确定哪些ERA5变量增加了卫星代表之外的信息。 这在设计能够近实时运行而不依赖再分析数据的探测器时很重要.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题表述

blocks.en: Given geostationary satellite observations over the North Atlantic and Europe, optionally augmented with ERA5 reanalysis fields, we classify each grid point into one of four classes: cold front, warm front, occluded front, or no front (example in Appendix F ). We use UK Met Office surface-analysis charts as ground truth because they are available every six hours over the 2019–2024 study period and their graphical conventions allow more reliable automated digitisation than the charts of some other services. We use data from four additional services as independent baselines (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 鉴于对北大西洋和欧洲的对地静止卫星观测,可选地与ERA5再分析场相加,我们把每个网点分为四等之一:冷锋、暖锋、斜锋或无前锋(附录F为例)。 我们使用英国气象局的地表分析图作为地面真相,因为这些图在2019-2024年的研究期内每六小时提供一次,而且它们的图形常规可以比其他服务的图更可靠地实现自动化数字化。 我们使用另外四个服务的数据作为独立基线(附录B)。

blocks.en:
We train two models with a Swin-UNet ( Liu et al., 2021 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) inspired by Aurora ( Bodnar et al., 2025 ) (Appendix A ) that differ only in their inputs.
These are the single-service variants of the SATFRONT detector ( Dravilas et al., 2026 ) , trained only on UK Met Office labels. The main SATFRONT model instead uses labels from five services.
The satellite-only model ( OBS ) uses 15 satellite-derived channels: eight infrared channels (3.8–13.3 μ \mu m) from the GEO-Ring geostationary data record ( EUMETSAT, 2026 ) at approximately 5 km resolution on the equal-area HEALPix grid, and seven deterministic features derived from the brightness temperatures following the ASII scheme ( NWC SAF, 2022 ) . The satellite + + ERA5 model ( HYB ) adds 28 ERA5 fields ( Hersbach et al., 2020 ) : six atmospheric variables at four pressure levels (1000–700 hPa) and four additional surface variables. For analysis, we group the ERA5 variables into winds (10 fields), moisture (8), temperature (5), and mass (5). Appendix A lists all input channels. Because ERA5 becomes available only after several days, we use HYB as a diagnostic upper bound on what reanalysis adds to this detector, not as an intended operational model. We train on 2019–2022, validate on 2023, and test on 2024.
blocks.zh:
我们用由Aurora(Bodnar等,2025年)(附录A)所启发的Swin-UNet(Liu等,2021年;Cao等,2023年)来训练两个型号,这些型号仅在投入上有所不同.
这些是SATFRONT探测器(Dravilas等,2026年)的单服务变体,仅接受英国气象局标签的培训. 主要的SATFRONT型号取而代之的是使用从5种服务获得的标签.
卫星专用模型(OBS)使用15个卫星衍生信道:8个红外信道(3.8-13.3 μ\mu mi)取自GEO-Ring地球静止数据记录(EUMETSAT,2026年),分辨率约为5千米,位于平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平地平 卫星++ERA5模型(HYB)增加了28个ERA5场(Hersbach等,2020年):6个大气变量为4个压力级(1000–700 hPa)和另外4个地表变量. 为了进行分析,我们将ERA5变量分为风(10个田地)、水分(8)、温度(5)和质量(5)。 附 录 A 列出所有输入通道 。 因为ERA5在几天后才开始使用,所以我们使用HYB作为诊断上限,在重新分析对这个探测器添加什么,而不是作为预定的操作模型. 我们于2019–2022年列车,2023年验证,2024年测试.

blocks.en: 3.2 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.2 实验装置

blocks.en: We first compare the satellite-only and satellite + + ERA5 models, then use three analyses to identify which ERA5 variables explain the performance difference: (i) cross-modal probing tests which ERA5 fields the satellite-only encoder can already predict, (ii) variable-group ablation measures the effect of removing each ERA5 group from HYB, and (iii) single-group addition measures the gain from adding each ERA5 group alone to OBS.
blocks.zh: 我们首先比较了卫星和卫星+ERA5模型,然后用三个分析来确定哪些ERA5变量解释了性能差异:(一)ERA5的跨模式验证测试,ERA5操作了卫星编码器已经可以预测的,(二)可变组减缩测量将每个ERA5组从HYB中移除的效果,(三)单组加分测量将每个ERA5组单独添加到OBS中所产生的收益.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Analysis of ERA5 variable groups. Top: linear predictability ( R 2 R^{2} ) from the frozen satellite-only encoder (best stage) and gain over a randomly initialised encoder, with 95% CIs. Near-sfc: 1000/925 hPa and 10 m fields. Dashed: positive control. Bottom: drop in CSI@150 when a group is replaced by values from another date.
blocks.zh: 图1:ERA5变量组分析. 顶部:从被冻结的仅限卫星编码器(最佳阶段)得到线性可预见性(R 2 R^{2}),通过随机关闭编码器得到收益,拥有95%的CI. 近斯克:1000/925 hPa和10米田地. 被骗:正控. 下: 当一个组从另一个日期被数值所取代时, 将下降为 CSI@ 150 。

blocks.en: We freeze the OBS encoder and extract features from each of its four hierarchical stages. Successive stages reduce spatial resolution and increase channel dimension. At each stage, we fit per-pixel ridge regression to predict every ERA5 field from the encoder features. Because variables may be best resolved at different scales, we take each field’s highest coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ) on the 2024 test set across the four stages and average it within each variable group. To separate what training adds from what the inputs or architecture provide, we repeat the procedure with the raw satellite input and a randomly initialised encoder (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们冻结了OBS编码器,并从它的四个等级阶段中抽取特征. 相继阶段会减少空间分辨率并增加通道维度. 在每一个阶段,我们适合每像素脊回流,从编码器特征中预测出每个ERA5场. 因为变量最好在不同尺度上解决,所以我们在2024年四个阶段的测试中取出每个字段的最高确定系数(R 2 R^{2}),并在每个可变组内取平均值. 为了将培训内容与投入或结构内容区分开来,我们用原始卫星投入和一个随机输入编码器(附录C)重复该程序。

blocks.en: For each variable group, we replace its HYB input channels with values from a randomly selected date and measure the change in CSI@150 relative to the unmodified HYB model. The replacement keeps each field’s spatial distribution but breaks its temporal alignment with the frontal labels.
blocks.zh: 对于每个可变组,我们用随机选择的日期的值来取代其HYB输入通道,并比照未修改的HYB模型测量CSI@150的变化. 该替换保留了每个字段的空间分布,但打破了它与前置标签的时间相匹配.

blocks.en: We train three additional models, each combining the satellite inputs with one ERA5 variable group, using the same architecture and training procedure as OBS and HYB. We add temperature and mass as one group because, by the hypsometric equation, the geopotential thickness between two pressure levels is set by the mean virtual temperature of the layer ( Holton and Hakim, 2013 ) . This grouping also limits the number of new training runs. We measure each model’s paired CSI@150 gain over OBS.
blocks.zh: 我们再培训三个模型,每个模型将卫星投入与一个ERA5可变组合并,使用与OBS和HYB相同的架构和培训程序. 我们把温度和质量作为一组,因为通过催眠等式,两个压力水平之间的地缘潜力厚度由地层的平均虚拟温度设定(Holton和Hakim,2013年)。 这种分组还限制了新培训的数量。 我们测量每个模型的配对 CSI@150 增益。

blocks.en: We report the critical success index at a 150 km tolerance (CSI@150), following Justin et al. (2025) . A ground-truth front pixel counts as detected if a predicted pixel of the same class lies within 150 km, and a predicted pixel counts as a false positive if no ground-truth pixel of the same class lies within 150 km. We compute CSI per class and average over the three classes. We estimate 95% confidence intervals for the difference Δ \Delta between two models (e.g., HYB − - OBS) with a paired moving-block bootstrap (Appendix C ) and report P ⁡ ( Δ ≤ 0 ) P(\Delta\leq 0) , the fraction of bootstrap samples with zero or negative improvement. Every paired comparison with OBS, HYB, or the random encoder in Section 4 has P ⁡ ( Δ ≤ 0 ) < 10 − 3 P(\Delta\leq 0)<10^{-3} . All results use a single training seed. We compare the models with the operational ASII product ( NWC SAF, 2022 ) and with the agreement between analyses from different meteorological services, measured against the same ground truth (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 我们以150公里的容能(CSI@150)报告关键成功指数, 如果同一类的预测像素位于150千米以内,则地面真实前像素算作检测出,如果同一类的预测像素没有地面真实前像素位于150千米以内,则预测像素算作虚假正数. 我们计算每个班级的CSI和三个班的平均数。 我们估计两个模型(如 HYB − - OBS ) 之间的差值95%的置信间隔, 带一对相接的行走区块靴( Appendix C ) , 并报告 P → ( Δ 0 ) P (\ Delta\leq 0 ), 带零或负改进的靴子样本的分数 。 每与 OBS, HYB 或 第 4 节中的随机编码器作一对比较,都有 P ⁡ (Δ 0 ) < 10 − 3 P (\Delta\leq 0) < 10^{-3}. 所有结果都使用单一的训练种子. 我们将这些模型与可操作的ASII产品(NWC SAF, 2022年)以及不同气象部门根据同一地面真理(附录B)进行的分析之间达成的协议进行比较。

blocks.en: 4 Results and discussion
blocks.zh: 4. 结果和讨论

blocks.en: Table 1 compares OBS and HYB with two reference baselines (Appendix B ). OBS reaches CSI@150 = 0.402 =0.402 , approximately three times the ASII score ( 0.143 0.143 ). The OBS score also lies within the range of agreement between analyses from different meteorological services ( 0.277 0.277 to 0.501 0.501 ), and Met Éireann agrees most closely with the UK Met Office. These comparisons provide context, not an upper bound. The services differ in local information, conventions, and geographic priorities, whereas we train and score OBS on the UK Met Office convention. HYB reaches 0.575 0.575 ( Δ = + 0.173 \Delta=+0.173 , 95% CI [ 0.163 , 0.183 ] [0.163,0.183] ), a 43 % 43\% improvement over OBS. The gain is similar across front types ( + 0.164 +0.164 , + 0.174 +0.174 , and + 0.180 +0.180 for cold, warm, and occluded fronts) and comes mainly from higher probability of detection ( 0.505 0.505 to 0.718 0.718 ).
blocks.zh: 表1将OBS和HYB与两个参考基线(附录B)作比较。 OBS达到CSI@150=0.402=0.402,大约是ASII分数(0.1430.143)的三倍. OBS的得分也属于不同气象部门的分析(0.277 0.277到0.501 0.501)之间的协议范围,Met Éireann最密切地同意英国气象局. 这些比较提供了上下文,而不是上限。 这些服务在地方信息、公约和地理优先事项方面各不相同,而我们则根据联合王国气象局会议培训和评定OBS。 HYB达到0.575 0.575 ( =+0.173\Delta=+0.173,95% CI [0.163,0.183] [0.163,0.183]),比OBS改进了43% 43. 增益相近于前列型(+0.164+0.164,+0.174+0.174,并有0.180+0.180用于冷,取暖和被围口的前列),主要出自更高的检测概率(0.505 0.505到0.718 0.718).

blocks.en: Table 1: CSI@150 on the 2024 test year (Met Office ground truth). Overall is the mean over the three front types; brackets give 95% CIs. All per-class improvements exclude zero ( P ⁡ ( Δ ≤ 0 ) < 10 − 3 P(\Delta\leq 0)<10^{-3} ).
blocks.zh: 表1:2024试验年的CSI@150(Met Office地面真相)。 总的来说,是三个前列类型的平均值;括号给出95%的CI. 所有每类改进都排除了零(P QQ (QQ 0.

blocks.en: In the probe (Figure 1 , top), temperature is the ERA5 group that the frozen OBS encoder predicts best ( R 2 = 0.88 R^{2}=0.88 ), followed by moisture ( 0.60 0.60 ) and mass ( 0.59 0.59 ), while winds are the least predictable ( R 2 = 0.23 R^{2}=0.23 ). High temperature predictability is consistent with the direct thermal information in infrared radiances, whereas the encoder can infer wind only indirectly from cloud and moisture patterns ( Velden et al., 2005 ) . A randomly initialised encoder already shows the same ranking ( R 2 = 0.69 R^{2}=0.69 for temperature and 0.05 0.05 for winds). Training improves all groups by + 0.18 +0.18 to + 0.28 +0.28 but does not close the gap for winds.
blocks.zh: 在探测器(图1,顶部)中,温度是冷冻的OBS编码器预测最佳的ERA5组(R 2 = 0.88 R^{2}=0.88),其次是水分(0.60 0.60)和质量(0.59 0.59),而风是预测最少的(R 2 = 0.23 R^{2}=0.23). 高温的可预测性与红外辐射中的直接热能信息一致,而编码器只能从云和水分模式中间接推断出风(Velden等,2005年). 随机登入的编码器已经显示相同的排名(R 2 = 0.69 R^{2}=0.69),温度为0.050.05. 训练改进了所有组别,增加了+0.18+0.18到+0.28+0.28,但并没有为风而缩小差距.

blocks.en: In the ablation (Figure 1 , bottom), replacing winds or moisture lowers CSI@150 by 0.21 0.21 and 0.31 0.31 , whereas replacing temperature or mass causes much smaller decreases ( 0.04 0.04 and 0.03 0.03 ). Replacing one group also breaks its correlations with the other groups, such as the thermal-wind relationship between winds and temperature. We therefore compare the wind-and-moisture block with the temperature-and-mass block and do not rank the groups within each block.
blocks.zh: 在膨胀(图1,下方)中,以0.21 0.21和0.31 0.31取代风力或水分更低的CSI@150,而取而代之的温度或质量则造成更小的减少(0.04 0.04和0.03 0.03)。 取而代之的一组也打破了与其他组的关联,如风与温度的热风关系. 因此,我们将风湿区块同温度和质量区块进行比较,不将每个区块内的各组进行排名。

blocks.en: In the single-group addition experiments (Appendix D ), adding each group alone to OBS yields similar gains: + 0.118 +0.118 for winds, + 0.138 +0.138 for moisture, and + 0.132 +0.132 for temperature and mass. Temperature and mass have little effect when ablated but provide comparable gains when added alone, consistent with strong correlations among the ERA5 groups. Winds are the clearest case in which low predictability from the satellite encoder coincides with a large ablation effect.
blocks.zh: 在单组加成实验(Appendix D.)中,将每个组单独加入OBS产生相类似的收益:风能+0.118+0.118;水分+0.138+0.138;温度和质量+0.132+0.132. 温度和质量在减速时作用不大,但在单独加时则提供可比较的增益,这与ERA5组之间的强烈关联是一致的。 风能是卫星编码器的低可预期性与巨大的衰减效应相巧合的最明显的例子.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Annual frontal frequency (2024, all front types, smoothed at ∼ 150 {\sim}150 km for display).
blocks.zh: 图2:年度前卫频率(2024,所有前卫类型,平滑为~150 {\sim}150公里以显示).

blocks.en: The improvement from ERA5 grows with the tolerance, from + 0.116 +0.116 at 50 km to + 0.173 +0.173 at 150 km, while the gain in probability of detection stays nearly constant (Appendix E ). This pattern is consistent with HYB detecting fronts that OBS misses. OBS also partly reproduces the annual Met Office frontal-frequency map (Pearson correlation 0.37 0.37 ), and ERA5 raises this correlation to 0.53 0.53 (Figure 2 ). Among front types, occluded fronts show the largest improvement in front placement in individual analyses ( + 0.180 +0.180 ), but ERA5 reduces the mean-squared error (MSE) of their annual frequency map by only 5.5%. Cold and warm fronts improve on both measures, with MSE reductions of 47% and 39% for the single-service models used here. With the five-service models of Dravilas et al. (2026) , the cold-front MSE instead rises by 3.5%.
blocks.zh: 从ERA5的改进随着耐受性而增长,从50公里处的+0.116+0.116到150公里处的+0.173+0.173,而检测概率的增益几乎保持不变(附录E.). 此模式与OBS所忽略的HYB检测前列一致. OBS还部分地复制了一年一度的Met Office前相频图(Pearson conversation 0.37 0.37 ),而ERA5则将这一关联提高到了0.53 0.53 (图2 ). 在前列类型中,被占用的前列显示个人分析前列位置的改善最大(+0.180+0.180),但ERA5将其年频图的平均值误差(MSE)只减少了5.5%. 冷暖两条措施都有所改善,这里使用的单一服务模式的MSE减少了47%和39%。 以Dravilas等人(2026年)的五服务模式,冷锋MSE转而上升了3.5%.

blocks.en: Our results show that satellite observations alone provide substantial information for frontal detection, while adding ERA5 raises CSI@150 from 0.402 0.402 to 0.575 0.575 . Our analyses help explain this gap. The probe and the ablation agree most clearly on low-level winds. Winds are the ERA5 variables least predictable from the satellite representation and, together with moisture, those whose replacement most reduces performance. For occluded fronts, ERA5 strongly improves detection on individual charts (CSI@150) but barely reduces the error of the annual frequency map, consistent with reanalysis providing instantaneous dynamical information that infrared imagery does not directly measure.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,仅卫星观测就为前方探测提供了大量信息,而加上ERA5,CSI@150从0.402 0.402提高到0.575。 0.575 (英语). 我们的分析有助于解释这一差距。 探测器和衰竭器在低级风能上最明确地达成一致. 风是从卫星代表中最不可预测的ERA5变量,加上水分,其替换最能降低性能的变量。 对于被关闭的战线,ERA5在单个图表(CSI@150)上大力改进了检测,但几乎没有减少年频图的误差,符合再分析提供瞬间动态信息,而红外图像并不直接测量.

blocks.en: These conclusions remain subject to several limitations. Linear probing measures which information the representation encodes, not what the decoder actually uses ( Ravichander et al., 2021 ) , and our ablations disrupt correlations among ERA5 variables. We also evaluate one domain, architecture, and training seed. Nevertheless, cross-modal probing of a frozen unimodal encoder can estimate how much of a candidate modality the existing representation already predicts, before any multi-modal model is trained. The same approach could be applied to other combinations of observations and variables in Earth observation.
blocks.zh: 这些结论仍受若干限制。 线性探测测量方法,其中信息表示编码,而不是解码器实际使用的内容(Ravichander等,2021年),我们的分解干扰了ERA5变量之间的关联. 我们还评估一个领域、建筑和培训种子。 尽管如此,在培训任何多式联运模式之前,对被冻结的单式编码器进行跨模式检验可以估计现有代表已经预测的候选模式的多少。 同一方法可以适用于地球观测中的其他观测和变量组合。

blocks.en: Both configurations use a Swin-UNet encoder–decoder segmentation network [ Liu et al., 2021 , Cao et al., 2023 ] , adapted to two dimensions from the three-dimensional Swin U-Net processor in Aurora [ Bodnar et al., 2025 ] . The encoder uses a convolutional patch-embedding stem followed by four stages. After the first stage, each subsequent stage halves the spatial resolution and doubles the channel width. Each stage applies windowed self-attention with alternating shifted windows, allowing information to propagate across windows. A symmetric decoder with skip connections restores the original grid resolution. Unlike Aurora, our model does not use a three-dimensional pressure-level axis, Perceiver encoding, or foundation-model pre-training. Dravilas et al. [2026] give a more detailed description of the architecture. The single-service variants used here have one output head, whereas the five-service model SATFRONT has one per service.
blocks.zh: 两个配置都使用Swin-UNet编码器-解码器分解网络[刘等,2021年;曹等,2023年],从Aurora的三维Swin U-Net处理器来适应两个维度[Bodnar等,2025年]. 编码器采用相接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接接 在第一阶段之后,之后的每个阶段将空间分辨率减半并翻倍频道宽度. 每个阶段都采用窗口式自留式,并交替移动窗口,使信息能够在窗口之间传播。 带有跳过连接的对称解码器会恢复原有的网格分辨率. 与奥罗拉不同的是,我们的模型不使用三维压力级轴,Perceiver编码,也不使用地基模型前训练. 达维拉斯等. [2026]更详细地描述了该建筑. 这里使用的单服务变体有一个输出头,而五服务模式SATFRONT则每个服务一个.

blocks.en: The satellite input contains eight infrared brightness temperatures at approximate central wavelengths of 3.8, 6.2, 7.3, 8.6, 9.7, 11.0, 12.0, and 13.3 μ \mu m, together with seven auxiliary features. Following ASII [ NWC SAF, 2022 ] , we compute these features from the brightness temperatures of the 6.2, 11.0, and 12.0 μ \mu m channels. The first two are differences between channels and are sensitive to upper-atmospheric moisture and cloud properties. The remaining five are spatial filters of the 11.0 μ \mu m channel that highlight local anomalies, cloud texture, cloud edges, curved cloud structures, and large-scale cloud bands. All seven features use satellite data only. The 28 ERA5 fields comprise geopotential height, specific humidity, relative humidity, temperature, and horizontal wind components ( u u , v v ) at four pressure levels (1000, 925, 850, 700 hPa), plus 2-metre temperature, mean sea level pressure, and 10-metre wind components ( u 10 u_{10} , v 10 v_{10} ). OBS uses the 15 satellite channels, while HYB uses all 43 channels (15 satellite plus 28 ERA5 fields). We map the satellite observations from the HEALPix grid to a regular 0.05 ∘ 0.05^{\circ} latitude–longitude grid using nearest-neighbour interpolation and bilinearly interpolate the ERA5 fields to the same grid.
blocks.zh: 卫星输入含有八个红外亮度温度,大约中央波长为3.8、6.2、7.3、8.6、9.7、11.0、12.0和13.3 μ \ mu m,以及七个辅助特征。 根据ASII [NWC SAF, 2022],我们从6.2, 11.0 和 12.0 μ\ m 通道的亮度温度计算出这些特征. 前两个是通道之间的差异,对上层大气湿度和云性敏感. 其余5个是11.0 μ \mu m通道的空间滤波器,能突出局部异常,云纹,云边,曲线云结构,并有大规模云带. 所有7个特征只使用卫星数据。 28 ERA5场包括地缘潜力高、特有湿度、相对湿度、温度和水平风能部分(u u, v.),分4个气压水平(1 000、925、850、700 hPa),外加2米气温、平均海平面压力和10米风能部分(u 10 u_{10},v 10 v_{10})。 OBS使用15个卫星频道,而HYB则使用全部43个频道(15个卫星外加28个ERA5场). 我们利用相邻最近的插值,将HEALPix网格的卫星观测图绘制成正线0.05 + 0.05 + Circ}纬度-经度网格,并将ERA5区划入同一网格。

blocks.en: Appendix B Reference baselines
blocks.zh: 附录B 参考基线

blocks.en: The two reference rows in Table 1 provide external context. We score the operational NWC SAF ASII product [ NWC SAF, 2022 ] , a rule-based satellite + + NWP front detection product (the ASII-NWP variant), against the same 2024 Met Office charts (1453 of the 1462 test timestamps) using the same CSI@150 metric as for the learned models. The Met Éireann row shows the agreement between analyses from different meteorological services. To measure this agreement, we score the 2024 surface-analysis charts of four other services in place of the model predictions, against the charts of the UK’s national meteorological service (UK Met Office) used as ground truth throughout. The four services are the Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI), the German Weather Service (DWD), the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute (KNMI), and the Irish Meteorological Service (Met Éireann). For each service, we evaluate only the overlap with the Met Office domain and timestamps for which both services provide an analysis (359 for Met Éireann, 366 for DWD, 893 for FMI, and 1460 for KNMI), so these scores do not use exactly the same samples as the models. Agreement ranges from 0.277 0.277 (FMI) to 0.501 0.501 (Met Éireann). This variation reflects not only differences in frontal positioning but also differences in analysis conventions, available local information, and geographic focus, as each service primarily analyses its own region of interest. The range therefore provides context for model performance but does not represent a ceiling on achievable detection skill. No directly comparable machine learning baseline exists because no prior detector has been trained and evaluated on the same geographic domain, time period, and labelling convention.
blocks.zh: 表1中的两个参考行提供了外部背景。 我们使用与所学模型相同的CSI@150公分,对运行中的NWC SAF ASII产品[NWC SAF, 2022],一种基于规则的卫星+NWP前测产品(ASII-NWP变体)进行评分,对相同的2024 Met Office图(1462测试时间戳中的1453)进行评分。 Met Éireann一行显示不同气象部门的分析意见一致。 为了衡量这一协议,我们以联合王国国家气象局(UK Met Office)的图表为基准,将2024年其他四项服务的地表分析图取而代之。 这四个机构是芬兰气象研究所(FMI),德国气象局(DWD),荷兰皇家气象所(KNMI)和爱尔兰气象局(Met Éireann). 对于每项服务,我们只评价与Met Office域名和时间戳的重叠,两种服务都提供分析(Met Éireann359个,DWD366个,FMI893个,KNMI1460个),因此这些分数并不完全使用与模型相同的样本. 协议范围从0.277 0.277 (FMI)到0.501 0.501 (Met Éireann). 这种差异不仅反映了正面定位的不同,而且还反映了分析惯例、现有当地信息和地理重点的不同,因为每个部门主要分析各自感兴趣的区域。 因此,范围为模型性能提供了上下文,但并不代表可实现的检测技能的上限。 没有可直接比较的机器学习基线,因为没有前作的探测器在相同的地理领域、时间段和标签惯例上受过训练和评价。

blocks.zh: 附录C 代表性分析详情

blocks.en: We freeze the OBS encoder and extract features from each of its four stages. At each stage, we fit a per-pixel ridge-regression model to predict each of the 28 ERA5 fields from the encoder features, using 500 training-year timestamps sampled at regular intervals. We pool each ERA5 target to the corresponding feature resolution using adaptive average pooling and subsample pixels by a factor of four during fitting. We standardise all features before regression. We select the ridge penalty from { 0.1 , 1 , 10 , 100 } \{0.1,1,10,100\} using a 20% held-out split of the training subset. We evaluate R 2 R^{2} on the 2024 test year, take the maximum for each field across the four encoder stages so that each variable is evaluated at its most favourable resolution, and then average within each variable group. We compute all 95% confidence intervals in this paper using a paired moving-block bootstrap over the 1462 test timestamps (block length 20, B = 1000 B=1000 resamples). A value of P ⁡ ( Δ ≤ 0 ) < 10 − 3 P(\Delta\leq 0)<10^{-3} means that no resample gave Δ ≤ 0 \Delta\leq 0 . All results use a single training seed.
blocks.zh: 我们冻结了OBS编码器,并从其中四个阶段的每一个阶段提取特性. 在每个阶段,我们都安装了每像素回脊模型,从编码器特征中预测出28个ERA5字段的每个字段,使用定期取样的500个训练年时间戳. 我们利用适应性平均集合和子样本像素,将每个ERA5目标集合到相应的特性分辨率中,在合适时以四倍为系数. 在回归前我们把所有特征标准化。 我们从{0.1, 1, 10, 100}{0.1, 1, 10, 100} 中选择脊刑, 使用20%的悬断分出 训练子集。 我们在2024年的测试年评估R 2 R^{2},在四个编码器阶段对每个字段取最大值,以便每个变量按最有利的分辨率评估,然后在每个可变组内平均。 我们计算本文95%的置信间隔, 使用在1462个测试时间戳(区间长度为20, B = 1000 B = 1 000个复标)上的一对行走区块的靴子。 P 的值 QQ ( QQ 0 ) < 10 - 3 P (\ Delta\leq 0) < 10\ 3} 表示没有再现 QQ 0\ Delta\leq 0 (英语). 所有结果都使用单一的训练种子.

blocks.en: We repeat the same procedure with two controls. The first replaces the encoder features with the raw satellite input, pooled to each feature resolution. The second uses features from two independently randomly initialised encoders with the same architecture and averages R 2 R^{2} across the two. These controls distinguish the contribution of the trained representation from that of the inputs or architecture alone. As a verification, predicting two of the model’s own input channels from its encoder features gives R 2 ≈ 0.99 R^{2}\approx 0.99 . Table 2 reports the results by variable group.
blocks.zh: 我们重复同样的程序,有两种控制。 第一种是将编码器的特性取而代之的是原始卫星输入,集合到每个特性分辨率上。 第二种使用两个独立随机登录的编码器的特性,其结构相同,平均R 2 R^{2}横跨两个. 这些控制将训练有素的代表的贡献与投入或架构的贡献区分开来。 作为验证,从该模型的编码器特性中预测出该模型本身的两个输入道,可以给出R 2 → 0.99 R^{2 → 大约 0.99 (英语). 表2按可变类别报告结果。

blocks.en: Appendix E ERA5 improvement across tolerances
blocks.zh: 附录E ERA5 跨容忍度的改进

blocks.en:
Table 4 reports the paired improvement in CSI from adding ERA5 (HYB − - OBS) at each tolerance. The gain is smallest at 50 km ( + 0.116 +0.116 ), peaks at 150 km ( + 0.173 +0.173 ), and decreases slightly to + 0.165 +0.165 at 250 km. However, because both models achieve higher CSI at larger tolerances, the absolute gain alone cannot distinguish additional detections from improved positioning. The relative gain also decreases with tolerance, from 48 % 48\% at 50 km to 43 % 43\% at 150 km and 32 % 32\% at 250 km.
CSI combines two components, the probability of detection (the fraction of observed front pixels matched by predictions) and the success ratio (the fraction of predicted front pixels matching observed fronts). The gain in probability of detection remains nearly constant, between + 0.20 +0.20 and + 0.21 +0.21 , across all tolerances from 50 to 250 km. If ERA5 primarily improved the positioning of fronts already detected by OBS, this gain would diminish at larger tolerances as displaced OBS predictions begin to match the observations. Instead, the persistent gain is consistent with HYB detecting fronts missed entirely by OBS, which count as additional detections regardless of tolerance. In contrast, the success-ratio gain decreases from + 0.16 +0.16 at 50 km to + 0.05 +0.05 at 250 km, indicating that HYB also places its predicted fronts closer to the analysed fronts.
blocks.zh:
表4显示,CSI在每种耐受性上都增加了ERA5(HYB - - - OBS),从而有相应的改进。 增收幅度最小为50公里(+0.116+0.116),高峰为150公里(+0.173+0.173),250公里略为降至+0.165+0.165. 然而,由于两种型号在更大的能耐性下都实现了更高的CSI,因此仅靠绝对增益无法区分额外探测与改进定位. 相对收益也随着耐受性而减少,从50公里的48%.下降到了150公里的43%.和250公里的32%.32%.。
CSI结合了两个组件,即探测概率(观测到的前像素与预测相匹配的分数)和成功比(预测到的前像素与观测到的前像素相匹配的分数). 探测概率的增益几乎保持不变,在+0.20+0.20到+0.21+0.21之间,在所有可容度从50到250公里之间. 如果ERA5主要改进了OBS已经探测到的战线的位置,这种增益在更大的耐受度下会减少,因为迁移的OBS预测开始与观测值相匹配. 相反,持续的增益与完全被OBS忽略的HYB检测前列一致,不管耐受性如何,都算作额外的检测. 相形之下,成功率增益从50公里的+0.16+0.16下降到250公里的+0.05+0.05,表明HYB也使其所预测的战线更接近被分析战线.

blocks.en: The main-text evaluation reports quantitative results averaged over the full 2024 test year. Figure 3 instead illustrates OBS and HYB predictions for a single test timestamp. The top-left panel shows the Met Office analysis. The top-right panel shows HYB, which reproduces the frontal structure more completely and follows the Met Office analysis more closely. The bottom-left panel shows OBS, which detects the main systems but breaks many fronts into short, scattered segments and misses others. These fragments make the frontal structure hard to read, so the bottom-right panel shows the same OBS prediction after a morphological closing that bridges gaps of up to about 12 pixels, followed by removal of connected regions smaller than 120 pixels. We apply this step only to OBS, because the HYB predictions already form continuous fronts. This post-processing is for visualisation only (as in an operational display) and does not affect any reported metric, which we always compute on the unprocessed predictions of both models.
blocks.zh: 主文评价报告了整个2024年测试年的平均量化结果。 图3显示的是OBS和HYB对单一测试时间戳的预测。 左上方的面板显示Met Office的分析. 右上角面板显示HYB,它更完整地复制了前部结构并更紧密地遵循了Met Office的分析. 左下方的面板显示OBS,它检测出主系统,但将许多前方突破为短而分散的片段并错过了其他部分. 这些片段使得前部结构难以被读取,因此从下到右面的面板显示的是相同的OBS预测,在形态学的收尾后,会将大约12个像素的空隙相接,然后去除小于120像素的相接区域. 我们只将这个步骤应用于OBS,因为HYB的预测已经形成了连续的前沿. 这种后处理只用于可视化(如同操作显示),并不影响任何已报告的度量,我们总是根据两个模型的未经处理的预测来计算.
